decisions.title: Agent-initiated decision intake and ADR triage
decisions.statement: 讨论中形成的长期决定需要由 Agent 主动捕获、留痕并在正确检查点发起 ADR 或需求确认，而不是等待用户记得要求写 ADR。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Use an append-only Decision Inbox for durable discussion decisions; Agent-owned triage classifies each decision and proposes a new ADR when architecture conditions apply. ADRs may exist without a REQ when they retain an originating DEC.

triage.rationale: The rule changes the cross-cutting governance contract and requires implementation of registries, gates and tests.

decisions.title: Explicit unreviewed approval and 0.6.0 first-wave authorization
decisions.statement: 增加“批准，但未仔细查阅”的状态，并据此批准版本重排和第一批开发。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Add approved_unreviewed design status with a mandatory approval note; authorize REQ-HOST-002 and REQ-ACTION-001 for the first 0.6.0 implementation wave while leaving later requirements frozen.

triage.rationale: The approval state changes the cross-cutting governance contract and requires implementation and tests.

decisions.title: Harden Action results approvals and observability
decisions.statement: 先继续 0.6 硬化：补 ActionResult 元数据、Action Manager、审批票据、二进制输出、幂等和迟到结果测试。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Treat Action result metadata and approval receipts as durable first-class data; expose an Action manager; preserve binary artifacts; prevent duplicate side effects for providers that require idempotency; and never accept late remote results as success.

triage.rationale: The change affects execution trust, persistence and every Action consumer, so it is both a durable architecture rule and an implementation requirement.
